# invitation invitee

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:invitationInvitee`](gmeow-invitationInvitee.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/invitationInvitee>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent invited to the event. Non-functional: a joint invitation may name several invitees.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EventInvitation`](../classes/gmeow-EventInvitation.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:invitationInvitee`](gmeow-invitationInvitee.md) from [`gmeow:EventInvitation`](../classes/gmeow-EventInvitation.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name an agent on the receiving end of an invitation — the invitee whose [`gmeow:rsvpStatus`](gmeow-rsvpStatus.md) records their response.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the organizer (model that as the inviting party / agreement role) and avoid forcing one value — a joint invitation may list several invitees, so it is non-functional.

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) invitees; each invitee's own response lives on [`gmeow:rsvpStatus`](gmeow-rsvpStatus.md), distinct from the organizer's [`gmeow:invitationStatus`](gmeow-invitationStatus.md).
